$schema.description: The schema to which this token store conforms.

TargetName.description: The name, without extension, of the file this Token Store describes. Or empty if the name is not a single file.

TargetExtension.description: The extension of the file this token store describes. Or empty if the name is not a single file. Do not prefix with a '.'

TargetFormat.description: The human readable name of this file format, ex: 'GZip Archive'. This should be kept short ideally.

Description.description: A longer description of the target format to avoid TargetFormat getting too long.

FormatOwner.description: The application that owns the binary format this tokenstore describes. (Example: 'GameName:Variant')

FormatOwnerVersion.description: The build version of the format owner software.

Namespace.description: The namespace that the compiled C# assembly for this Token Store will be placed in. (It will be prefixed by a Gecko specific root namespace)

Generator.description: The tool or script that generated this token store.

Frozen.description: Date the token table was validated (YYYY-MM-DD)

MagicNumber.description: A magic number in the file header that identifies the format. Can be supplied as an integer in decimal or hexadecimal notation (0x12345678) up to 64 bits/8 bytes.

MagicOffset.description: The offset in the file where the Magic Number is to be found. Can be supplied as an integer in decimal or hexadecimal notation (0x12345678).

DataEncoding.description: Endianness for the file. Defaults to little-endian if not specified.

StringEncoding.description: String encoding for the file. Defaults to UTF-8 if not specified.

Include.description:
Path to another token store to include.
This is intended for handling file headers which have a common structure across many files.

FirstTable.description: The ID of the first token table, from which all others will be called.

TokenTable.description: Array of Token Tables describing a single table's struct layout. Must be unique.

SizePrefix.description: Specifies the size prefix for the table. 'Ignored', 'None', or not specifying this field means no size prefix.

NoAlign.description: If true, the table will be processed without byte-alignment.

Token.description: A single token describing how to parse a field.

Class.description: The type of token to process.

StorageFlags.description: Flag options: Normal, Optional, CountArray, FixedArray, SizeArray, SentinelArray, ByOffset, ByIndex, Resource, Payload, Comment, Absolute, Relative

MappingValue.description: Value that can be used to identify an enum to map to. Or whatever.

Parameter.description: Sets fixed array/string size. Also serves as a default value for integers if non-zero.
